Two shapes delivered on 2026-10-03 must be refused: a record keyed by terminal (dumb and colour) and a record keyed by measurement (population, named_alone and so on). The finding names the field, says it is not a flat suite record, and lists the keys a flat record needs. A worker running check-manifest sees the finding while the shape is still its to change.
